description: Fetch a web API or resource and automatically settle Bitcoin HTTP 402 paywalls via Cashu NUT-24 (X-Cashu) or Lightning L402.

body.description: Optional request body string (for POST requests)

maxAutoPaySats.description: Optional per-request ceiling in satoshis for automatic 402 settlement

preferRail.description: Preferred settlement rail when both headers are offered (default: cashu)

url.description: Target HTTP/HTTPS URL to fetch (protected by SSRF Guard)

name: fetch_with_402_payment
